content.text: FacebookLog InLog InForgot Account?Special Operations Warrior Foundation's PostSpecial Operations Warrior Foundation Verified accountJanuary 16, 2020 · Shared with Public“My wife, Navy Senior Chief Petty Officer Shannon Kent, was killed in action on January 16th 2019 in Manbij Syria conducting Special Operations against ISIS. After she was killed, I was faced with the reality of being a single parent, the Special Operations Warrior Foundation immediately contacted me and ensured that I was able to enroll our son in preschool and explained all of the benefits the foundation will provide for our two boys. SOWF is like family to me and countless SOF survivors. I cannot thank the foundation and its donors enough for providing me with the peace of mind in knowing my children will have access to top level education.” CWO2 Joe KentCWO2 Joe Kent is a retired Green Beret. Special Operations now has the solemn duty of funding the education his and SCPO Shannon Kent's two young sons, Joshua and Colton.All reactions:1K111 comments290 sharesLikeCommentMost relevant Ben J AminShannon has a lot of friends visiting her today.6y31Susan AndersonMy deepest condolences to you, your family and friends. Very grateful your children and you will have support and a good education. I thank her and your family for your ultimate sacrifice. May she rest in peace.6y14Ted VigneauThank you for your story so many times we see the final picture of our brothers and sisters in the military who gave the ultimate sacrifice for our country but we never know the full impact of the loss to the family so thank you for your sacrifice also. May she Rest In Peace with Gods blessing. Amen.6y8Paul LeemanMay she Rest in Peace, may the Lord watch over you folks and guide you through this rough journey.6y8Marshal BlazerMy condolences brother. I served with Shannon in Afghanistan. She was an amazing person. Until Valhalla sister.6y12Billy PilgrimShe was a legend. So many amazing stories. She will never be forgotten. 6y4Prime ApThank you SOWF for continuing to support these families.
